notes: «لكعب بن مرة أو مرة بن كعب» gives the addressee two forms. Read as one link with the first form; the second is the compiler's doubt.
Shurahbil asks Ka'b to narrate what he heard from the Prophet, so Ka'b is the last link. «قال أبو داود سالم لم يسمع من شرحبيل» is the compiler's remark, not a link.
